Empires & Puzzles Zengar Costume Review: The Farmer of Doom

Zengar traded his axe for a hoe and his rage for... well, more rage, but agricultural. The Farmer Costume takes a lackluster hero and supercharges him with modern stats and a skill that hurts everyone, not just Fire heroes. It's time to plow the battlefield.
Farmer Zengar: Harvesting Souls with a Great Frost Hoe

Zengar's "Farmer" costume (C1) is one of the most drastic glow-ups in Empires & Puzzles history. Released in August 2025, it reimagines the crazed barbarian as a... crazed farmer? He swaps his class to Druid, his axe for a "Great Frost Hoe," and his stats for something that can actually survive a modern raid. Zengar went from "Zero" to "Hero" (or rather, "Farmer"). It's rare to see a costume fix a hero's fundamental design flaws so perfectly. He retains his anti-Fire identity but stops being useless against everyone else. Plus, killing a dark lord with a hoe is the kind of humiliation we play this game for.
A must-level if you have the costume.
